items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: When you were with Gene... I used to go to a place and play... I told Gene about him, and he got the job in the band.

ctx.x: Although Joe Smith used to play some pretty things.

Oh yeah. Also the other Smith, Russell Smith, used to play "Time On My Hands" and ...[?]... They played pretty things. But so could the White bands play pretty things. And that just wasn't my thing, you know.

You got to watch saying that, now, because we'll get another Leonard Feather deal going on here! Boy, that cat really hung me on the wall with that. Boy, that was really wrong, man. Talk about misquoting people. At any rate, it was just like that fight, that Gerry Cooney fight, you know. All of a sudden, I…

items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Even Gene's wife, she said... I told them, 'Well, I'll have a book.' She says, 'You must be kidding.'

ctx.x: people! But I made it and everything.
Even Gene's wife, she said... I told them, 'Well, I'll have a book.' She says, 'You must be kidding.' I said, 'No, I ain't kidding.' Hell, I turned out to be the big thing for the band, you know.
